concepts.title: Range of Data
concepts.definition: The range is the simplest measure of dispersion, calculated as the gap between the largest and smallest values in a dataset.
question_patterns: calculate the range of the given data
find the range for the set of numbers
what is the range of the following observations
determine the range of the series
how much is the range of the provided data

solution_steps.action: subtract the minimum value from the maximum value
solution_steps.explain: range is defined as the difference between the largest and smallest observations

concepts.title: Mean Deviation about Mean
concepts.definition: Mean deviation about the mean is the average of the absolute differences between each data point and the arithmetic mean of the set.
concepts.key_idea: Average absolute distance from the mean.
question_patterns: find the mean deviation about the mean
calculate the mean deviation from the mean
what is the mean deviation about the mean for these values
determine the mean deviation about mean
how to compute the mean deviation about the mean

solution_steps.explain: mean is the sum of observations divided by the number of observations

solution_steps.action: find the sum of absolute deviations
solution_steps.explain: calculate abs(x_i - mean) for each observation and sum them

solution_steps.action: divide the sum of absolute deviations by n
solution_steps.explain: this gives the mean of the absolute deviations

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving mean deviation about mean.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the arithmetic mean. Step 2: find the sum of absolute deviations. Step 3: divide the sum of absolute deviations by n. Working: sum_x / n, sum_abs_dev, total_abs_dev / n.
worked_examples.answer: Mean Deviation about Mean applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the arithmetic mean. Step 2: find the sum of absolute deviations. Step 3: divide the sum of absolute deviations by n. Working: sum_x / n, sum_abs_dev, total_abs_dev / n.
worked_examples.answer: The method of mean deviation about mean leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Variance of Ungrouped Data
concepts.definition: Variance is the arithmetic mean of the squares of the deviations of observations from their mean, representing the degree of scatter.
concepts.key_idea: Average squared distance from the mean.
question_patterns: calculate the variance of the data
find the variance of the given observations
what is the variance for the set
determine the variance of these numbers
compute the variance of the series

solution_steps.explain: find the average of the observations
calculate (x_i - mean)**2 for each and sum them

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving variance of ungrouped data.
worked_examples.solution: Step 1: calculate the mean. Step 2: sum the squared deviations. Step 3: divide by n. Working: sum_x / n, sum_sq_dev_vals, sum_sq_dev / n.
worked_examples.answer: Variance of Ungrouped Data applied step by step gives the required result.

worked_examples.answer: The method of variance of ungrouped data leads to the required value or conclusion.

concepts.title: Standard Deviation
concepts.definition: Standard deviation is the positive square root of the variance, providing a measure of dispersion in the same units as the original data.
question_patterns: calculate the standard deviation
find the standard deviation of the data
what is the standard deviation for these values
determine the standard deviation
how much is the standard deviation

solution_steps.explain: first find the variance of the dataset
standard deviation is the square root of variance

worked_examples.question: Solve a typical question involving standard deviation.

worked_examples.answer: Standard Deviation applied step by step gives the required result.
